deck_cards.mechanics: Once per long rest, as an Action, mark an unoccupied space within 10 ft as the landing zone for a plan you describe at the table (improvised wire, bait, wedge, whatever). The first Soft Open enemy that enters that space this combat makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d6 bludgeoning, slashing, or fire damage (your choice when marking) and has the Prone condition. Then the mark is spent until you rest.
deck_cards.limits: One mark. Allies who enter it are safe (it knows). Damage capped at 1d6 (rung 2). Story Box deed is only for an unscripted player-invented plan the GM did not put in the Soft Open page — not for merely using oil, a bomb, or any catalog trap that fires You Call That a Trap? (A-136). Distinct from A-136. Not a Sapper's Table. Not bound.
